units.title: Introduction to Biochemical Engineering & Sustainable Bioprocesses
topics: Scope and evolution of biochemical engineering
role of biochemical engineers in food
comparison of chemical and biochemical processes

units.title: Enzyme Kinetics and Biochemical Reaction Engineering
topics: enzyme kinetics and Michaelis– Menten model
effects of pH, temperature, and substrate concentration
applications of enzymes in green chemistry and sustainable manufacturing

units.title: Fermentation technology and Microbial Growth Kinetics

units.title: Downstream Processing, Sustainable Bioprocess Applications

Course aligned with SDGs 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 17 through sustainable biochemical engineering and circular bioeconomy practices
